verbs.description: Start the Claude Code daemon now if none runs, and wait until it answers. Returns ok=false with reason=daemon_down when it does not come up in time, is held, or cannot run here. Pass peer=<node> to bring another node's daemon back with no ssh. When this verb itself does not answer, the node's keep service is down: run `awm services restart cch` on that node.

params.description: Seconds to wait for the daemon. Default 30.
params.name: timeout

verbs.description: Stop the Claude Code daemon and keep it stopped until daemon_release or the hold expires. Its sessions keep running for 20 minutes without the daemon, then die, so a hold lasts at most that long. Nothing can start, resume or message a session while it is held.

params.description: Why, shown in daemon_status.
params.name: reason

params.description: How long the hold lasts. Default 600, at most 1200.
params.name: seconds

verbs.description: End a daemon_hold and start the daemon again.

params.description: With cwd: the line the session gets once the move applied, such as the new scope's brief: the caller's own in its follow-up, another session as a message.
params.name: brief

verbs.description: Start a named background session in a scope's worktree.

params.description: The project the scope belongs to. Without a scope it is only a hint in the brief.
params.name: project

params.description: The scope whose worktree is the session's directory. Omit it to start in the lobby.
params.name: scope

params.description: Treat project and scope as a suggested route, as for a follow-up session (sessions.md R18): start in the lobby and let the session choose.
params.name: suggest

params.description: The task the session joins (sessions.md R57 step 3). Pass your own from reflection whoami when you start a session for your task.
params.name: task_id

params.description: main or worker on the task. Defaults to worker when a session calls, else main.
params.name: role

params.description: The first task. Without one the session starts empty.
params.name: prompt

params.description: Text appended to the system prompt (claude --append-system-prompt). Unlike the prompt, a compaction never rewrites it.
params.name: system_prompt

params.description: The auto-compact window in tokens, 100000 to 1000000. Claude Code compacts about 33k below it. Omitted means the model's own window.
params.name: autocompact

params.description: The session's name, <task>/<descriptor> for the sessions of one task (sessions.md R56). Defaults to the scope, or lobby-<hex> in the lobby.
params.name: name

params.description: A model alias or full name, chosen to fit the task. A call without one is refused.
params.name: model

params.description: low, medium or high, chosen to fit the task. High is the upper limit; xhigh and max are refused.
params.name: effort

params.description: A permission mode (plan, acceptEdits, auto, manual, dontAsk, bypassPermissions). Omitted means skip-permissions. The session starts in this mode and can always switch to bypass, so a plan-mode start runs in bypass once its plan is approved.
params.name: permission

params.description: A label recorded with the session, which a gateway gate can key on. Defaults to worker.
params.name: mode

params.description: Tool names the session may not use.
params.name: disallowed_tools

params.description: Tool names approved without a prompt, which keeps a dontAsk session from having them denied (for example mcp__awm__*).
params.name: allowed_tools

params.description: The only built-in tools the session holds (claude --tools). Omitted means all.
params.name: tools

params.description: Confine file tools to the worktree and ignore user settings (claude --restricted).
params.name: restricted

params.description: Load only the awm MCP server, from the workspace config.
params.name: strict_mcp

params.description: Remote Control, on unless false, named for the session with each `/` as `-`; a plain label names it instead. The result's `link` is the claude.ai link, null with a `link_reason` if it has not connected within a few seconds.
params.name: remote_control

params.description: Pin the job, so the daemon's idle retirement passes it over. A pinned job is a kept session: stopping it unpins it and removes it with `claude rm`.
params.name: pin

params.description: Append the worker lifecycle brief to the system prompt: work in the right scope, ask Tony through the board, sign off and stop when done. Default true. A pinned start never gets it.
params.name: brief

params.description: Who the brief says started the session when no session called, such as 'Tony from Discord'. A calling session is named instead.
params.name: started_by

params.description: The session_id this session replaces. Its last turns are appended to the prompt, it is stopped (and removed when pinned) if cx started it, and the new session's lineage records it.
params.name: replaces

params.description: Tags to set on the scope (scope tag), such as ['lab', '<person>'] for work a lab member asked for. A tagging failure is returned as a warning and does not stop the start.
params.name: tags

params.description: The starting session's pid.
params.name: pid
